readiness_check: Document the legal entity, service scope, decision authority, and accountable leadership for the managed-services practice
evidence_to_retain: Current organization record, approved service catalogue, responsibility matrix, and named executive owner

readiness_check: Maintain written policies for security, privacy, acceptable use, access, change, incident response, continuity, and supplier management
evidence_to_retain: Approved policy set with owners, versions, approval dates, and review schedule

readiness_check: Track obligations from contracts, regulation, insurance, customer commitments, and recognized frameworks without claiming unsupported certification
evidence_to_retain: Obligation register with source, scope, owner, evidence, exception, and review date

readiness_check: Define roles, competency expectations, background-screening boundaries, training, and supervision for privileged personnel
evidence_to_retain: Role descriptions, competency matrix, training records, supervision model, and approved screening policy

readiness_check: Use named identities, MFA, least privilege, managed administrative devices, and timely joiner-mover-leaver controls
evidence_to_retain: Access review, MFA evidence, role assignments, privileged-device inventory, and offboarding samples

readiness_check: Record each customer's included and excluded services, shared responsibilities, authorized requestors, maintenance constraints, and escalation contacts
evidence_to_retain: Signed scope, responsibility matrix, service schedule, contact register, and approved exceptions

readiness_check: Reconcile customer, site, user, endpoint, server, network, cloud, identity, and vendor records to observed evidence
evidence_to_retain: Dated asset baseline, source provenance, reconciliation result, exceptions, and ownership

readiness_check: Inventory and control administrative accounts, delegated access, service identities, APIs, vault references, VPNs, and emergency access
evidence_to_retain: Privileged-access inventory, business justification, approval, expiry, test result, and review evidence

readiness_check: Define service hours, request channels, priorities, response and restoration clocks, escalation, and customer communication
evidence_to_retain: Service handbook, SLA definitions, queue mappings, escalation tests, and communication templates

readiness_check: Measure service demand, acknowledgement, restoration, resolution, reopen rates, backlog, and exception aging without hiding exclusions
evidence_to_retain: Source-dated service reports with calculation rules, denominators, exclusions, trends, and owner commentary

readiness_check: Define monitored scope, data freshness, thresholds, severity, routing, maintenance behavior, suppression, and recovery evidence
evidence_to_retain: Monitoring policy, coverage report, alert-routing test, suppression review, and exception register

readiness_check: Move vulnerabilities and patches from intake through scope, risk, pilot, deployment, failure handling, validation, and closure
evidence_to_retain: Vulnerability register, patch policy, pilot evidence, cohort denominator, failure queue, and closure proof

readiness_check: Authorize and audit remote support, scripts, commands, automation, software deployment, reboots, and other privileged actions
evidence_to_retain: Approval record, target snapshot, actor, action, output, outcome, exceptions, rollback, and audit export

readiness_check: Maintain independent detection, security contacts, containment authority, evidence preservation, and out-of-band communication paths
evidence_to_retain: Incident runbook, contact tests, log sources, tabletop record, lessons, owners, and retest dates

readiness_check: Retain searchable evidence for actor, customer, endpoint, action, outcome, time, failure, denial, configuration change, and remote session
evidence_to_retain: Audit-log coverage matrix, retention settings, export test, investigation sample, and gap register

readiness_check: Define protected scope, repositories, retention, encryption, alert ownership, recovery objectives, and tested restores
evidence_to_retain: Backup inventory, job evidence, restore test, measured result, exception, owner, and acceptance

readiness_check: Operate when the primary RMM, PSA, identity, documentation, communication, or vendor support path is unavailable
evidence_to_retain: Continuity plan, alternate contacts and tools, bounded drill evidence, backlog reconciliation, and corrective actions

readiness_check: Authorize changes with scope, risk, canary, maintenance window, stop conditions, rollback authority, communications, and closure
evidence_to_retain: Approved change record, target list, test results, exceptions, rollback proof, and post-change review

readiness_check: Classify provider and customer data, limit collection and access, control retention and transfer, and avoid secrets in operating registers
evidence_to_retain: Data inventory, classification, access review, retention schedule, transfer record, deletion evidence, and exceptions

readiness_check: Perform risk-based due diligence on vendors, subcontractors, platforms, integrations, and critical dependencies
evidence_to_retain: Supplier inventory, evidence requests, findings, contract controls, subprocessor review, exit plan, and renewal decision

readiness_check: Make pricing units, minimums, add-ons, implementation, renewal, cancellation, taxes, and exit costs reviewable before commitment
evidence_to_retain: Approved quote comparison, contract summary, order form, renewal calendar, authority, and acceptance

readiness_check: Report service health, coverage, risk, exceptions, decisions, and named next actions using source-dated evidence
evidence_to_retain: Customer report, QBR record, decisions, accepted risks, action owners, due dates, and follow-up

readiness_check: Maintain export, credential revocation, agent removal, data disposition, transition, billing closure, and post-exit monitoring procedures
evidence_to_retain: Exit plan, sample exports, dependency map, revocation test, removal test, data disposition, and acceptance

readiness_check: Review incidents, failed changes, missed service targets, audit findings, complaints, and recurring exceptions through corrective action and retest
evidence_to_retain: Improvement register with root-cause evidence, owner, due date, validation result, residual risk, and closure
